title: Seat mapping
intro: Which IP, MAC and nick belong to which seat. Floorbit merges it from the check-in page, plugins and seat files. What you enter here wins over all of them; fields you leave empty come from the other sources. Only accounts with seat access see it: this is personal data.
empty: No seat has a mapping yet.
removeQuestion: Remove the hand entry for seat {{seat}}? The other sources show again.
importHelp: Columns: seat, ip, mac, nick, note (the first line names them). Every row is checked first; if one is wrong, nothing is imported.
replace: Replace all hand entries (seats not in the file lose theirs)
